reasons.claim: The text gives two alternative transmitters at the fifth level and marks the doubt as a note rather than a link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ أَوْ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ اَلْعِجْلِيِّ اَلشَّكُّ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ

reasons.claim: The Imam is named in the question after the chain and is therefore the last link.
reasons.quote: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: Muhammad and Ali are co-transmitters at one level, while the following phrase identifies their father rather than adding a link.
reasons.quote: حدثني محمد، وعلي، ابنا الحسن بن أبي الحسن البراد

reasons.claim: The father is named as al-Mundhir and Abu Usayd is written twice in succession as one link.
reasons.quote: أن أباه المنذر حدثه عن أبي أسيد، أن أبا أسيد، حدثه

reasons.claim: Both readers leave the first isnad ending at Muhammad b. Khalid al-Barqi without reaching the saying, whereas the text introduces a second isnad before the shared tail.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْبَرْقِيِّ وَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Ja'far b. Najiyah and Abu Abd Allah are written once at the end for both routes and belong in the shared tail.
reasons.quote: عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ نَاجِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع)

notes: Both routes share the tail from Ja'far b. Najiyah to Abu Abd Allah.

reasons.claim: The first two tahwil branches meet at Shu'bah as stated by the dual marker.
All three branches then meet at Sulayman and share the tail to Abd Allah.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن سليمان، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters meet at al-Hasan b. Mahbub, and Ya'qub al-Sarraj addresses Abu Abd Allah, making the Imam the last link.
reasons.quote: قالوا جميعاً: حدثنا الحسن بن محبوب، عن يعقوب السراج، قال: قلت لأبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: Both shaykhs meet at Ibn Numayr, whose repetition in succession is one link, followed by Hisham, his father, and Aisha.
reasons.quote: كلاهما عن ابن نمير، قال ابن العلاء حدثنا ابن نمير، حدثنا هشام، عن أبيه، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: The first branch runs from Harun b. Abd Allah through Ma'n to Malik, not through Ibn al-Qasim.
reasons.quote: أخبرني هارون بن عبد الله، قال حدثنا معن، قال حدثنا مالك،

reasons.claim: Al-Harith b. Miskin is the compiler's own shaykh in a second branch («وأنا أسمع») through Ibn al-Qasim to Malik, not a co-transmitter with Malik under Ma'n.
reasons.quote: والحارث بن مسكين، قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع، - واللفظ له - عن ابن القاسم، قال حدثنا مالك،

reasons.claim: Both branches share the tail from Ibn Shihab through the co-transmitters Hamzah and Salim to Abd Allah b. Umar.
reasons.quote: عن ابن شهاب، عن حمزة، وسالم، ابنى عبد الله بن عمر عن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: Al-Harith b. Miskin is the compiler's shaykh in a second branch meeting the first at Malik; both share the tail from Ibn Shihab.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through al-Nadr b. Muhammad (omitting the gloss «هو الجرشي اليمامي») to Iyas b. Salamah and his father.
reasons.quote: حدثنا النضر بن محمد، هو الجرشي اليمامي حدثنا عكرمة بن عمار، عن إياس بن سلمة، عن أبيه

reasons.claim: The single chain runs from Qutaybah through Layth and Nafi' to Ibn Umar, whose saying is relayed.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قتيبة، حدثنا ليث، عن نافع، أن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Two tahwil branches meet at Suhayl and share the tail through his father to Abu Hurayrah.
reasons.quote: حدثنا موسى بن إسماعيل، حدثنا وهيب، ح وحدثنا وهب بن بقية، عن خالد، نحوه عن سهيل، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة
